items.rationale: Covered under 5.2.6(b), inspecting and assessing the damage, capped at EUR 3,000; the price prior and Case 20 point to about 524.
Covered under 5.2.6(a), leak location. This line shares the EUR 1,000 sub-limit with line 3, and the combined estimate stays below it.
On-site time of the leak-location technician is covered under 5.2.6(a), within the shared EUR 1,000 cap; 2.5 hrs at roughly 60/hr.
Under 5.2.6(c), one vehicle charge per contractor per invoice is reimbursed, up to EUR 70 net (83.30 gross). The price prior is about 79.

items.description: Repair of actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3, leakage from material ageing counts as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking. Repair of the two weeping joints at the customary upper price.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3, sections not themselves shown to be leaking are not covered; 3.5 and 7.1.5 also exclude work beyond the affected parts.
Under 7.1.9 (no improvement on the pre-loss standard), the betterment difference is borne by the policyholder.
Under 5.2.6(c), one vehicle charge per contractor per invoice is allowed, capped at EUR 70 net (83.30 gross).
